annotations.title: Registered leases for up to 100 properties

description:
`property_lease` for up to 100 properties in one call, per-item outcomes
    (ok | no_lease | not_found | error) in input order. Charged per property
    answered — the sum of the single calls, never more.
    UK only. Costs 5 credits (5p). Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: property_lease_batch
